seed_selection: Two fixed unused seeds; no score inspection; original phase335 and original durations

registry.numeric_fingerprint_check: At first generation against historical registry and this cohort

arms.B: Original E1 gate and ordering, K=1
arms.C: K=2, public first check; task preferences frozen before first result, live safety checks
arms.D: K=2, identical first check; replan after real reference using shared public state

comparison: D vs C for same-budget feedback; do not attribute D vs B budget/first-logic changes to AI

model_loop.stop_after: first legal nonduplicate model child, evaluated on all six cases
model_loop.prompt: Only anonymous public completed trajectories and labeled development simulation scores
model_loop.editable: One or two Workflow enum fields; no safety/budget/data/physics edits

deliverables: One-page four-question decision and one next hypothesis
